name: three_createWorld_wrapper_conservative_instancing_v5
description: Conservatively rewrites source modules that export createWorld(THREE, scene) into wrappers around the original factory. At runtime, the wrapper preserves original initialization and update behavior, then inspects the created scene graph and batches only sibling opaque Mesh objects with fully compatible geometry data and render-relevant material signatures into THREE.InstancedMesh. It compares actual geometry attribute/index arrays and groups, detaches original meshes from the graph while keeping the original objects alive for existing update references, preserves stable semantic identities from userData.semanticId or name, and updates instance matrices from each detached original mesh's local matrix under its original parent after every update. It keeps the batch under the original parent to preserve ancestor motion, avoids transparent/array materials, avoids package/build/test/SDK files, and returns no changes when prerequisites are not matched.
